Issue Description: Editorial Georgia serif font applied to italic emphasis in hero heading (intro h1 em), clashing with modern Barlow Condensed display font
User Impact: Visual dissonance; looks like an editorial blog template rather than a bespoke digital tactical football simulator
Current Implementation: font-family: Georgia, Times New Roman, serif; letter-spacing: -.07em; color: #658069;
Recommended Fix: Standardize to var(--font-display) with font-style: italic and var(--color-accent) (#D4B77B)
Verification Method: Inspect hero h1 in browser at 1440px and 390px

Issue Description: Hero eyebrow index (#455f40) and eyebrow text (#68756a) yield 2.69:1 and 3.94:1 contrast ratios on dark canvas (#0E1014), failing WCAG 2.2 AA (4.5:1 minimum)
User Impact: Low readability for users with low vision or in bright mobile ambient lighting
Current Implementation: color: #455f40; color: #68756a;
Recommended Fix: Use semantic tokens: var(--color-accent) (#D4B77B, 9.85:1) for index, and var(--color-text-muted) (#A9ACB5, 7.62:1) for eyebrow
Verification Method: Chrome DevTools Lighthouse Accessibility contrast measurement

Issue Description: Control card subsection index numbers styled with Georgia serif italic (#86a38a)
User Impact: Dilutes sports dashboard identity; introduces unnecessary serif font into a technical interface
Current Implementation: font-family: Georgia, serif; color: #86a38a; font-size: 14px; font-style: italic;
Recommended Fix: Change to var(--font-display) with tabular numbers and var(--color-accent) gold accent
Verification Method: Inspect Squad Lab control card headings

Issue Description: Stoppage time LED digit board uses generic system Courier New monospace fallback instead of tabular condensed athletic numerals
User Impact: Looks like an unstyled desktop terminal rather than a modern stadium electronic board
Current Implementation: font-family: Courier New, Courier, monospace; font-size: 26px;
Recommended Fix: Set font-family: var(--font-display) with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums and letter-spacing: 0.08em
Verification Method: Trigger second-half injury time in broadcast mode and inspect LED board

Issue Description: Conflicting focus-visible outlines: line 152 sets 3px green outline (#95b843), line 2844 overrides to 2px gold (var(--accent))
User Impact: Inconsistent focus styling and CSS dead code bloat
Current Implementation: Two conflicting focus-visible CSS rule blocks separated by 2,700 lines
Recommended Fix: Consolidate into single root focus indicator rule: outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px;
Verification Method: Keyboard Tab navigation focus test across all interactive elements

Issue Description: Icon-only action buttons lack aria-label or accessible text descriptions
User Impact: Screen readers announce uninformative empty button or raw SVG filename, violating WCAG 2.2 4.1.2
Current Implementation: Raw <button><svg>...</svg></button> without aria-label or text node
Recommended Fix: Add aria-label="Close dialog" and aria-label="Clear filter query" to all icon-only buttons
Verification Method: Screen reader audit and Chrome Accessibility tree check

Issue Description: Scouting search input and filter dropdowns lack associated <label> elements or aria-label attributes
User Impact: Screen reader users cannot understand the purpose of filter dropdowns, violating WCAG 1.3.1 and 3.3.2
Current Implementation: <select id="scoutRoleFilter"><option>...</option></select> without aria-label or label
Recommended Fix: Add explicit aria-label to all filter dropdowns (e.g. aria-label="Filter by position category")
Verification Method: Axe Core automated scan in browser

Issue Description: Top navigation bar contains 7 desktop tabs with no horizontal scroll or hamburger collapse on screens under 768px
User Impact: Navigation wraps into multiple clumsy rows or clips off-screen on mobile devices, consuming vertical viewport
Current Implementation: display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap;
Recommended Fix: Implement horizontal swipeable nav-track with scroll snap and fading edge mask for mobile viewports (<768px)
Verification Method: Inspect header navigation at 375px and 390px viewports

Issue Description: Excessive decorative emoji usage in dropdown option groups and UI microcopy
User Impact: Creates an amateurish casual template feel rather than an authoritative professional football simulation tool
Current Implementation: Option labels formatted with multiple emojis
Recommended Fix: Replace emojis in select dropdowns and formal UI labels with clean text or crisp SVG icons
Verification Method: Inspect club and nation dropdowns across all modes

Issue Description: Eliminated team cards in knockout tournament brackets display low opacity without clear textual status
User Impact: Users have difficulty distinguishing who won penalties or extra time matches in previous rounds
Current Implementation: opacity: 0.5; without explicit winner checkmark or status badge
Recommended Fix: Provide distinct winner pill (✓ W) and muted but accessible loser status with contrast-compliant text
Verification Method: Simulate quarter-finals and verify bracket card clarity

Issue Description: Two 11-player squad columns in 11v11 mode stack into an extremely tall single column on screens under 980px
User Impact: Requires over 2,400px of continuous vertical scrolling on mobile to review both teams
Current Implementation: grid-template-columns: 1fr on viewports <980px
Recommended Fix: Provide a segmented User 1 / User 2 tab toggle on mobile viewports (<768px) to toggle between squads cleanly
Verification Method: Inspect 11v11 team draft mode at 390px viewport

Issue Description: No standardized border-radius token system: values fluctuate arbitrarily between 2px, 3px, 4px, 5px, 6px, 7px, 8px, 9px, 10px, 12px, 14px, 16px, 20px
User Impact: Subtle visual incoherence across components; inconsistent corner rounding across cards, inputs, and buttons
Current Implementation: Hardcoded arbitrary pixel values across 171 individual CSS rules
Recommended Fix: Establish semantic radius scale: --radius-xs (3px), --radius-sm (4px), --radius-md (6px), --radius-lg (8px), --radius-pill (9999px)
Verification Method: Audit CSS variables in styles.css

Issue Description: Touchline shout buttons have small 32px height on mobile touch screens, failing WCAG 2.2 target size guidelines
User Impact: Difficult for mobile users to tap accurately during live match playback
Current Implementation: height: 32px; padding: 4px 10px;
Recommended Fix: Increase min-height to 42px on touch viewports or set min-target size to 44x44px per WCAG 2.5.8 / 2.5.5
Verification Method: Measure touch target bounding client rect on mobile

Issue Description: Replay vault match card displays action buttons (Replay, Export, Delete) with equal visual weight and low border contrast
User Impact: Destructive action (Delete) lacks visual warning; primary action (Replay) lacks prominence
Current Implementation: All 3 buttons use identical neutral background and font styling
Recommended Fix: Promote Replay to primary champagne gold style; style Delete with subtle warning hover and confirmation
Verification Method: Inspect Replay Vault page with saved matches

Issue Description: Footer contains only a single centered line with minimal links, feeling abrupt and disconnected from the luxury obsidian dashboard aesthetic
User Impact: Misses opportunity for helpful navigation shortcuts, keyboard helper hints, and offline engine status
Current Implementation: Single line with tagline, Local first, and GitHub link
Recommended Fix: Upgrade to a structured athletic dashboard status footer displaying engine build status, keyboard shortcuts (Space to play, 1-3 speeds), and documentation links
Verification Method: Inspect footer across desktop and mobile

Issue Description: 189 hardcoded hex color values remain scattered in styles.css from the pre-dark-mode redesign (e.g. #8a9a89, #5e7b4f, #68746a, #71984a)
User Impact: Technical debt; impedes theme maintainability and causes subtle color clashes between legacy olive-green and new Obsidian & Champagne Gold tokens
Current Implementation: Mix of CSS custom properties and raw hex codes
Recommended Fix: Refactor all remaining hardcoded hex colors to canonical CSS variables (--color-surface, --color-accent, --color-text-*)
Verification Method: Grep styles.css for hardcoded hex codes

Issue Description: HTML5 canvas lacks fallback text rendering and accessible screen-reader live region updates for visually impaired users
User Impact: Screen reader users cannot perceive 2D spatial player positions or ball physics
Current Implementation: exists but is not updated with live ball zone or ball carrier during ticks
Recommended Fix: Update #pitchAccessibleSummary dynamically with active ball zone (e.g. "Ball in final third with User 1"); provide detailed match commentary feed
Verification Method: Screen reader test with NVDA / VoiceOver during live match

Issue Description: Dream Team slot grid displays 11 starters plus 5 substitutes in a rigid multi-column layout that crowds on tablets (768px-1024px)
User Impact: Player names truncate aggressively; ratings overlap slot borders on iPad / tablet portrait screens
Current Implementation: grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr with tight 6px gaps
Recommended Fix: Optimize tablet breakpoint (768-1024px) to provide balanced cards with legible text truncation and clear rating badges
Verification Method: Inspect Dream Team Studio at 768px and 820px tablet viewports

Issue Description: Match events commentary feed items have dense 11px body text with minimal line-height (1.2)
User Impact: Fast-scrolling live text becomes visually fatiguing to read during high-speed simulation
Current Implementation: font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.2;
Recommended Fix: Increase line-height to 1.45 and set font-size: 12px for commentary prose
Verification Method: Observe live match commentary stream at 3x speed

Issue Description: Long national team or club names (e.g. Wolverhampton Wanderers"
User Impact: "Democratic Republic of Congo") wrap awkwardly around the center scoreline at 320px-375px"
Current Implementation: Header scoreline misaligns vertically; scores and team names overlap on narrow mobile viewports
Recommended Fix: display: flex; justify-content: space-between; without min-width or responsive font-size clamp
Priority: Use font-size: clamp(14px, 3.5vw, 22px) and text-overflow: ellipsis for team name containers
Verification Method: Low
column19: Test long club names at 320px and 360px viewport widths
